India's T20 series loss to Ireland sparks criticism and online mockery

The Indian cricket team lost a T20 series 0-2 to Ireland, leading to criticism of head coach Gautam Gambhir. Iceland Cricket's social media account posted a jibe at Gambhir, which went viral. Separately, Sunil Gavaskar questioned the decision to not debut young player Vaibhav Sooryavanshi during the series.
